subject: Compile-time arithmetic expressions
notes: Rule: 'The order of precedence and the rules for evaluation of compile-time arithmetic expressions are shown in 8.8.1' (cite.py --check 7.3.6.3 -> OK §7.3.6.3 1)). Precedence is carried by the shared arithmeticExpression grammar spine (additive > multiplicative > power > unary > primary); EvalArith folds each additive/multiplicative level LEFT TO RIGHT (§8.8.1.2 3) --check OK). Intermediates are not truncated (only the final result, at EvaluateArithmeticOperand). Probed with the pinned cobol.exe (probe/ctae/p1.cob, p2.cob, --std 2002/2014/2023): CONSTANT AS 2 + 3 * 4 = 14; 10 - 3 - 2 = 5; 12 / 2 * 3 = 18; (1 + 2) * 3 = 9; - 2 * - 3 = 6; 5 - 10 / 4 = 2 (2.5 untruncated intermediate); 7 / 2 + 0.5 = 4 (3.5 + 0.5, intermediate not truncated); >>IF 10 - 3 - 2 = 5 AND 12 / 2 * 3 = 18 selects; identical across editions. The unit Theory pins 2+3*4=14 and (2+3)*4-6/2=17 (spec-derived); the same-level left-to-right case has no test (probe only). || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 (compile-time arithmetic in DEFINE/EVALUATE/IF directives and constant entries; not 1985)
